## 中文
### 为什么做这个插件
[该节后续省略]
### 功能
| 功能 | 说明 |

| **三档任务模式** | 主线 / 均衡 / 静音——一个设置同时管住标记过的、没标记的，以及「别烦我」。 |
| **多主线标记** | 输入框 ☆、会话行「…」菜单、侧栏星标三个入口，可同时标

多个；点某颗星只取消那一个。 |
| **四类事件** | 完成、失败、提问、权限请求，每类独立开关、独立音效。 |
| **三种内置音效** | Chime / Success / Subtle，W

eb Audio 实时合成，不加载音频文件；音量 0–100%。 |
| **每类事件自定义音频** | MP3 / OGG / WAV，≤ 512 KB，只存在当前浏览器，也只对这一类事件生效。 |

| **浏览器通知** | 每类事件、每个会话各一个 tag 并带 `renotify`，提问不会顶掉未读的完成通知；提问与权限请求要求常驻显示；点击直达对应会话。 |
| **当前会话提醒三档**

| 仅后台或最小化 / 切到其他应用时（分屏也算）/ 始终提醒。 |
| **等待子代理结束** | 父会话跑完但子代理还在跑时先不响，整波结束再提醒一次。 |
| **按会话静音** | 在会话行

「…」菜单里单独静音，不动全局设置。 |
| **设置页信息栏** | 版本号、GitHub、问题反馈，以及只有点击时才读 npm registry 的**检查更新**；中英双语界面；遵循 `pref
ers-reduced-motion`。 |
### 环境要求
Node.js 20 及以上，DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 及以上。端到端验证于 0.2.1-rc.2，安装层验证于 0.2.1-rc.4。更早的 DSH 版本用的是另一套会话 sto
以上，DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 及以上。端到端验证于 0.2.1-rc.2，安装层验证于 0.2.1-rc.4。更早的 DSH 版本用的是另一套会话 store API，不受支持。
### Why this exists
Running five DSH sessions at once is normal. A notifier that fires on every completion interrupts yo
u five times, while you are usually waiting for exactly one of them. The real cost is not the sound
— it is that after a few false alarms you stop trusting it and check the screen anyway.
attention-plugins gives sessions a priority. Mark what you are waiting for and it rings the moment i
t lands; everything else is pooled into a single "All tasks" chime when the wave goes idle.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The three modes each answer one question:
| Mode | Answers | Behaviour |
| **Main-line** (default) | "I only care about a few" | Marked sessions ring on completion or failur

e; the rest ring once per wave |
| **Balanced** | "Tell me about all of them" | Every session rings

on its own; nothing is aggregated |
| **Silent** | "Not now" | No sound, no notification on completi
on; questions and permission requests still alert |
Compared with an event-only notifier, the difference is not the sound but the question "when is it w
orth interrupting you":
|  | A plain four-event notifier | attention-plugins |

| When it rings | Every finished session | Marked sessions now, the rest once per wave |
| Modes | O

ne global switch | Main-line / balanced / silent |
| Granularity | Per event type | Per event type,
per session, per marker |
### Features
| Feature | What it does |
| **Three task modes** | Main-line, balanced, silent — one setting covers marked sessions, unmarked

ones, and "do not tell me". |
| **Multiple main-line markers** | Mark any number of sessions from th
e composer ☆, the session row "…" menu, or the sidebar star; clearing one star leaves the others alo

ne. |
| **Four event types** | Completed, failed, question, permission — each with its own switch an

d built-in sound. |
| **Three built-in sounds** | Chime / Success / Subtle, synthesized with Web Aud

io (no audio files shipped); volume 0–100%. |
| **Custom audio per event type** | MP3 / OGG / WAV up

to 512 KB, stored in this browser and played for that event type only. |
| **Browser notifications*
* | One tag per event type and session with `renotify`, so a question never replaces an unread compl

etion; questions and permissions ask to stay on screen; clicking one opens that session. |
| **Curre
nt-session tiers** | Background or minimized only / when the window is unfocused (split screen inclu

ded) / always. |
| **Wait for subagents** | A parent that finished while its subagents still run sta

ys quiet; the wave rings once when the last child is idle. |
| **Per-session mute** | Silence a sing

le session from its "…" menu without touching global settings. |
| **Settings meta bar** | Version,
GitHub, issues, and **Check for updates**, which reads the npm registry only when pressed; English a
nd Chinese UI; follows `prefers-reduced-motion`. |
### What's new in 0.2.2
- **Three task modes replace the old side-line alerting setting.** Existing configs migrate on load:

per-session → balanced, batch → main-line.
- **Click a notification to open its session**, and per-

event notification tags so alerts no longer overwrite each other.
- **Current-session alerts are thr

ee tiers** instead of a boolean — split screen is no longer permanently muted.
- **Wait for subagent

s, per-session mute, and custom audio for every event type.**
- **Meta bar** with the installed vers

ion, GitHub, issues, and a manual update check.
- **Fixes**: the "All tasks" aggregate could ring tw
ice in one wave; three 💡 teaching notes are gone from the settings panel.
Full list in CHANGELOG.md. Next up: a notification history view.
### Requirements
Node.js 20 or newer, DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 or newer. Developed and verified end to end on 0.2.1-rc.
2, and against the 0.2.1-rc.4 install layer. Older DSH releases used a different session-store API a
nd are not supported.
